This Spring Rye Brook Little League will begin its’21st season as an accredited Little League program. We plan on get- ting your 2026 Little League season underway earlier so that we can have more structured practices prior to the start of the sea- son. The Youth baseball and Little League softball ratings will take place in early March. Coaches will attend a mandatory coaches clinic to enhance their ability to teach the skills to our Little Leaguers. There will be practices built into the first half of the season on a weekly basis. Rye Brook Little League will have a dedicated website. The web- site will be the location to go to find out your league standings, scores, rosters, cancellations and statistics. The minor league baseball program will utilize a pitching ma- chine for all league games. There will be clinics every Friday af- ternoon emphasizing pitching, hitting and fielding.

The 2026 Rye Brook Little League will have playoffs for all Ma- jor league teams culminating in a Rye Brook Champion. We hope to see everyone at the ratings and hope to provide you with a wonderful and memorable Little League season.
